An app without a password now opens through the fortress like any other. The kit goes to 1.0.7, and the `fortress` and `notify` helpers built from it come along.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **An app without a password opens through the fortress.** A member whose app asks for no sign-in of its own answered `ui_no_login` and stayed shut, so you had to set a password before you could open it from another app. It now serves its interface, and an app with a password still asks for it on the opened page. Plugins get this with the `fortress` helper of this release.
- **The refusal of an older member names the right fix.** A member still on an older kit keeps answering `ui_no_login`, and the opening side said you should set a password there. It now says that app needs an update.

## ⚡ Improved

- **The published image takes the newest OS updates every week**, also between releases.
